# Evergreen — Horticultural Pegasus

Evergreen is Canterlot’s lime-green Pegasus landscaper from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Remember him as the tree-trimmer who warns Spike about dangerous trees, only to be persuaded to postpone his work in the name of Princess Twilight.

[![Evergreen — Friendship Is Magic (Hasbro/DHX Media), show capture shared on r/MLPLounge](https://preview.redd.it/looking-for-the-name-of-this-pony-hes-from-season-5-episode-v0-ca6frzi9f8qa1.jpg?auto=webp&s=00fbadfed9d147bd1d67cbfc58dc6926bcc68484)](https://www.reddit.com/r/MLPLounge/comments/1237yfb/looking_for_the_name_of_this_pony_hes_from_season/)

- Appearance: yellow-green coat, brown mane and tail, blue eyes, wings and a pine-tree cutie mark.
- Names: Evergreen and Douglas Spruce are fandom names (both documented in the linked 2023 discussion); their original coinage is unverified. Horticultural Pegasus is his television credit and licensed mobile-game name, not a personal name spoken in the episode. [Season-five credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_five)
- Speaking status: speaking minor character, voiced by Peter New (also the voice of Big Macintosh).
- Appearances: *Princess Spike* (S5E10, June 20, 2015), followed by a reported appearance in *The Point of No Return* (S9E5). [Pegasus character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies)
- Game: added to Canterlot in Gameloft’s licensed mobile game in April 2016 as a VIP reward, according to the [update 2.8 record](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Update_2.8).

## Important moments

Both scenes are from [Princess Spike (S5E10), episode transcript](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s05e10&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic); exact video timestamps unavailable.

1. **The public-safety warning** — He explains that the dragon-sneeze trees are unstable but agrees to delay trimming when Spike invokes Twilight’s authority, setting up the later disaster.
2. **Answering to Fancy Pants** — After the trees fall and the summit is flooded, he explains that he stopped because of the purported royal instruction, exposing the consequences of Spike’s decisions.

*Verification limits:* the Reddit post exposes the linked show-capture asset, but independent image loading and several wiki page reopens were blocked; the indexed wiki entries were available. No independently verified fan-art attribution or exact video timestamps were found.
